args.title: Ironbark Tooling Newsletter Summary – Retail Returns Logistics
args.body:
- Apparel return rates have climbed to 24%, making returns a major cost center for retailers.
- Consolidated return hubs reduce handling costs by about 20%, showing centralization pays off operationally.
- The companion research found that reselling returned items within 10 days preserves most of the product margin, highlighting speed-to-resale as key to profitability.
